name: SMARTS-UP Graduate Schools Mobility Scholarship (Université Paris Cité)
requiredDocuments: Cover/motivation letter (1 page): motivations for the chosen Master, career ambitions, interests, and reasons for choosing Université Paris Cité
Two letters of recommendation (written by a professor, teacher, or internship supervisor)
Academic transcripts from the 1st year of the Bachelor's/Licence onward
Research project (3-4 pages, references included): research theme and/or an identified lab/department for the internship
Where applicable, summaries of previous work (theses, books, internship reports, scientific articles)

timeline.resultsBy: Early April 2026 (waiting-list final decision in May 2026)
timeline.notes: Dates are the 2026-2027 cycle from the official 2026-2027 guidelines PDF. As of 2026-06, this cycle's application window (1 Dec 2025 - 16 Jan 2026) has already closed and results are out; it is the most recent published cycle. Laureates join Université Paris Cité in September 2026. A new 2027-2028 call typically opens around December 2026 - check mobility.smarts-up.fr.

benefits: Flat mobility grant of EUR 10,000 for one academic year (2026-2027)
Paid in three installments: one in semester 1 and two in semester 2
Open to Master 1 (M1) and Master 2 (M2) entry across the 28 Graduate Schools / preselected Master programs at Université Paris Cité (up to 200 grants offered)
mustKnow: NOT fully funded: a EUR 10,000 lump-sum grant only. The guidelines state explicitly it is 'une bourse et non un salaire' and 'ne sera pas suffisante pour votre séjour à Paris' - you must arrange additional income; there is no tuition waiver or living-stipend top-up beyond this lump sum.
Cannot be combined with any other scholarship; awarded for 2026-2027 only and cannot be deferred ('n'est pas cumulable avec une autre bourse ... ne peut être reportée').

Eligibility is restricted to first-time arrivals in a French university: you must be a foreign national, NOT already hold a French higher-education diploma, and not already be enrolled in a French university (double-degree students with UPCité are an exception). French nationals are excluded. No closed eligible-country list applies - a Bangladeshi national is eligible.
Only Master programs on the official eligible list (28 Graduate Schools) at https://mobility.smarts-up.fr/ qualify - you apply for a specific listed Master.

Bangladeshi (non-Europe) applicants must ALSO register in parallel on the Études en France / Campus France platform to obtain a student visa - a separate but mandatory procedure independent of the SMARTS-UP application.
M1 applicants need a foreign Bachelor's/Licence-equivalent (degree in hand by September 2026); M2 applicants need at least one full year of a related Master completed by September 2026.

Selection may include follow-up interviews ('prestation ... lors d'éventuels entretiens de suivi'); decision by email early April 2026, with a 15-day window to confirm acceptance or the grant passes to the next waiting-list candidate.
Grant is paid only after enrollment, into a French bank account in the student's name.
eligibleNationalities: Open to all foreign (non-French) nationals who are first-time arrivals in a French university and do not already hold a French higher-education diploma. No closed eligible-country list - Bangladesh is not excluded. French nationals are ineligible.
languageRequirements: Not specified in the scholarship guidelines; language requirements (French or English) are set by each individual Master program at Université Paris Cité.
applicationFee: No application fee mentioned in the guidelines (the complete application procedure lists six documents and no fee).
fundingCovers: Partial study grant (lump sum EUR 10,000) - explicitly not full living costs; no tuition waiver or insurance stated
bondObligation: None (no return-home or service bond; obligations are academic only - enrolment, attendance, follow-up questionnaire, alumni group)
renewalConditions: Non-renewable; awarded for one year (2026-2027) only and cannot be deferred.
